text: DG: Neither gates the trigger on my method. ma100 and ma200 and channel_upper are not tests I hold; my test is a fresh high after a normal pullback (C5), and DG shows it: D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.18, H1 HH/HL at pos_in_day_range_pct 96.7. I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high, ACT_NOW. Never regret a lower entry missed (C5). Print minervini's and elder-lens's conditions as their dissent. What would move me: a one-day reaction of one atr_14d off the day's high (my translation of C7), or a close under bar_low.
